decks.notes: The deck focuses on staying in control of the game by utilizing counterspells, board wipes, and card draw to outlast opponents. It also includes a companion to provide additional value and synergies. The mana base is designed to support the control strategy while also providing a good mix of colored sources. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own win conditions through card advantage and efficient removal spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and removal spells to apply pressure on the opponent. By combining powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and control the board. Additionally, cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Thoughtseize help disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong offensive presence. The deck also includes lands like Mutavault and Blightstep Pathway to ensure smooth mana curve and consistency in casting spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying small, efficient creatures and equipping them with powerful artifacts to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck runs a variety of equipment cards to boost the creatures' power and toughness, with additional protection from cards like Sheltered by Ghosts. With a low mana curve and aggressive playstyle, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game and finish them off before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's strategy, controlling the board with counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to outvalue the opponent by using Yorion as a companion for additional value, recurring powerful cards such as Narset and Omen of the Sea. The deck also utilizes cards like Grim Bauble and Stormchaser's Talent to dig for key cards while disrupting the opponent's game plan. With a mix of powerful threats and efficient removal, it aims to maintain control of the game and grind out a victory.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures and burn spells. By combining aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage with powerful burn spells like Lightning Helix and Boros Charm, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Ghitu Lavarunner and Slickshot Show-Off allows for additional damage to be dealt, while Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide extra utility and reach. Overall, the deck focuses on applying constant pressure and closing out games swiftly.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure with aggressive creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize. The deck also has a strong removal suite with cards like Fatal Push, Go for the Throat, and Blade of the Oni. Additionally, the inclusion of Mutavault and Blackcleave Cliffs provides additional versatility and mana fixing. The deck aims to close out games quickly by overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient threats and disruption spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of creatures and spells that aim to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the board and maintain pressure. The deck also includes hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's strategy, allowing the aggro strategy to continue uninterrupted. Overall, the deck aims to quickly establish board control and maintain a relentless assault on the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through various means such as removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse, as well as utilizing Leyline Binding to lock down opponent's threats. Additionally, the deck aims to generate card advantage and value through cards like Flicker of Fate and Up the Beanstalk. Zur, Eternal Schemer acts as a powerful win condition by fetching key cards from the deck and maintaining pressure on the opponent. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's strategy while providing flexibility in casting spells of different colors.

The primary focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing creatures with haste and direct damage spells to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. By playing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, combined with powerful burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and end the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. Additionally, cards like Manifold Mouse and Questing Druid provide additional threats and flexibility in different scenarios.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells in the early game. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize while deploying threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It also utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. The deck has a good mix of creature aggression and disruption, making it a strong choice for players looking to apply pressure while controlling the board.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures and using them to quickly overwhelm the opponent with damage. The deck includes cards that buff your creatures, protect them, and provide extra damage for quick victories. The combination of creatures with various abilities and combat tricks allows you to maintain board presence and pressure your opponent into making unfavorable trades. By maximizing the efficiency of your creatures and utilizing combat tricks effectively, you can create a strong aggro strategy that is difficult for your opponent to handle.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent's life total with efficient creatures and removal spells. It also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fear of Missing Out to generate advantage and pressure the opponent. The deck's key strategy is to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize while quickly closing out the game with powerful threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. By combining aggression with disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matchups.

The core strategy of this deck is to quickly and aggressively control the board by constantly sacrificing and recurring creatures with Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Mayhem Devil. The deck incorporates various sacrifice outlets, removal spells, and graveyard recursion to maintain pressure on the opponent while generating value from sacrificing creatures. The inclusion of Ygra, Eater of All provides additional versatility and power to the deck, allowing for explosive plays and strong finishers. By utilizing a combination of sacrifice synergies and efficient threats, this Aggro - Jund deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory through relentless aggression.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly assemble the Greasefang Parhelion combo, which involves using various cards to generate mana and protect your key combo pieces while quickly assembling the necessary components. The deck focuses on a combination of efficient removal spells, disruptive hand disruption, and powerful creatures to not only protect the combo but also threaten the opponent's life total. By efficiently using your resources and making calculated plays, you can overwhelm your opponent and secure victory using this unique and powerful combo strategy.

This deck focuses on sacrificing your own creatures to deal damage to your opponent and generate value. The key strategy is to use cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven to repeatedly sacrifice creatures and trigger abilities that deal damage. By maintaining a constant flow of sacrificing and recurring creatures, you can control the board and pressure your opponent. Support cards like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn help disrupt your opponent's game plan, while cards like Scavenger's Talent provide additional resources. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a consistent stream of aggression and value.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and card advantage engines. The deck utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for additional value and consistency. The deck aims to stall the game with cards like Omen of the Sea and Mazemind Tome, while using cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The win condition of the deck comes from generating card advantage and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Thundertrap Trainer.
